summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周四收高，道琼斯指数上涨逾十分之一，标准普尔 500 指数上涨逾 1%，纳斯达克指数上涨近 2%。

title: Meta signs new AI computing deals with data center firm Crusoe, Bloomberg News reports
title_zh: 据彭博社报道，Meta 与数据中心公司 Crusoe 签署新的人工智能计算协议
summary: Meta Platforms has secured new agreements to get AI computing power from data ‌center developer Crusoe, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, ‌as it strengthens infrastructure required to support its AI expansion.
summary_zh: 据彭博社周四报道，Meta Platforms 已与数据中心开发商 Crusoe 达成新协议，以获取人工智能计算能力，同时加强支持其人工智能扩张所需的基础设施。

title: Carvana opens 'car playground' for easy test drive booking
title_zh: Carvana开设“汽车游乐场”，方便试驾预订
summary: Carvana (CVNA) is launching 'car playground' where customers can setup test drive via the phone. Allison Worldwide Managing Director of Automotive, Rebecca Lindland, joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination to discuss how it works and how customers are reacting to it.
summary_zh: Carvana (CVNA) 正在推出“汽车游乐场”，客户可以通过手机设置试驾。艾里森全球汽车业务董事总经理丽贝卡·林德兰 (Rebecca Lindland) 与乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 一起探讨市场统治的运作方式以及客户对此的反应。

title: Intel jumps after Trump says Apple, Intel reached US chip deal
title_zh: 特朗普称苹果与英特尔达成美国芯片协议后，英特尔股价上涨
summary: Intel (INTC) surged 9% in premarket trading after President Trump said in a Truth Social post that Intel and Apple (AAPL) have agreed on a deal to design and build semiconductors in the US.
summary_zh: 特朗普总统在 Truth Social 帖子中表示，英特尔和苹果 (AAPL) 已就在美国设计和制造半导体的协议达成一致，英特尔 (INTC) 在盘前交易中飙升 9%。

title: Gas prices fall but chip demand is causing a new headache
title_zh: 天然气价格下跌，但芯片需求引发新的头痛
summary: Consumers may finally be getting some relief at the pump, with gas prices falling to their lowest levels since March following the Iran peace deal. But any savings could be offset elsewhere, as the AI-driven chip shortage pushes up the price of Apple (AAPL) iPhones.
summary_zh: 伊朗和平协议达成后，天然气价格跌至 3 月份以来的最低水平，消费者可能终于可以松口气了。但随着人工智能驱动的芯片短缺推高了苹果 (AAPL) iPhone 的价格，任何节省的成本都可能在其他地方被抵消。

title: SpaceX stock drops after breaking 3-day winning streak
title_zh: SpaceX股价在打破三天连涨后下跌
summary: SpaceX opened lower on Thursday, extending losses from the prior session.
summary_zh: SpaceX 周四开盘走低，延续前一交易日的跌幅。

title: Stocks market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq rally amid Iran deal optimism as AI chip trade reignites
title_zh: 今日股市：人工智能芯片贸易重燃，伊朗交易乐观，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数上涨
summary: Wall Street eyed the odds of Hormuz reopening after the interim US-Iran peace deal went into effect, and weighed signs the Fed is starting to lean toward a rate hike.
summary_zh: 华尔街关注美伊临时和平协议生效后霍尔木兹海峡重新开放的可能性，并权衡美联储开始倾向于加息的迹象。
